results.name: the synchronized sequence has its own version key
the draw keys are untouched, so no seed is re-dealt
the era hash is frozen, so a seed keeps its era
one submit carries players and coaches
each flow refuses the other's actions
the client can submit decisions and nothing else
a challenge replays the sequence it was minted under
the CPU commits both decisions before the user submits
no draft module can even see an entitlement
the API validates both halves before mutating
